description: Not for us: takes communities or rivals that discovery found off the business's lists, as Market's Not for us press does, so no later search lists or studies them again (a subreddit about something else, a rival that is not one). back: true puts ones set aside back. Read discovery_read first and pass each one's name or address as it lists them. Use it when the owner says a community or rival is not theirs or not relevant. Returns the ones set aside or put back, and any name not on file or matching several (pass its address then). It needs an act key.

back.description: false: set them aside (Not for us); true: put ones set aside back on the list

kind.description: community: a place where buyers gather (discovery_read communities); rival: a competitor (discovery_read competitors). One kind per call

names.description: each one's name or address as discovery_read lists it (a community: r/name or its url; a rival: its name or url)

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
